interface.longDescription: Gomry is an event platform for organizers. Connect your Gomry account to run your events from ChatGPT: see what's coming up, create and edit events, change ticket prices and limits, check who registered, look up contacts, invite and message attendees, and compare sales and page views across events. Use it when you want an answer about your events or a quick change without opening the dashboard. It works on your own Gomry data and respects your team role, and ChatGPT asks you before running anything that changes your data or emails people.
defaultPrompt: Change the date, venue or description of my next event
Update the ticket prices or limits for my next event
Invite one of my contacts to my next event

positive.prompt: On Gomry, change the description of the Directory Review Workshop to: Bring a laptop and your questions.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Directory Review Workshop, asks for confirmation, then replaces only its description with that text and confirms the change. The date, venue, tickets and attendees stay as they were, and nobody is emailed.

positive.prompt: Limit the VIP tickets for the Directory Review Summit on Gomry to 20.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Summit's VIP ticket type, asks for confirmation, then sets its quantity to 20. The VIP price (80 EUR) and the General Admission ticket do not change, and no one is charged or emailed.

positive.description: Invite a contact to an event
positive.prompt: Invite my contact Gabriela Pinto to the Directory Review Summit on Gomry.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Gabriela Pinto in the organization's contacts, says an invitation email will go to her address and asks for confirmation, then sends it and adds her to the Summit's guest list as invited, with no charge. If she is already on the guest list, it says so and sends nothing.

positive.description: Who is registered for an event
positive.prompt: How many people are registered for the Directory Review Summit on Gomry, by ticket type?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers 4 registered: 3 General Admission and 1 VIP. Invited guests who have not registered are not counted. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: What ticket types does the Directory Review Summit on Gomry have, and what do they cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists two ticket types: General Admission at 25 EUR and VIP at 80 EUR. Nothing is changed.

negative.description: Buying tickets as a fan. The app is for organizers and sells nothing in ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Buy me two tickets to the Taylor Swift concert in Madrid.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any Gomry tool. ChatGPT answers on its own or says Gomry can't help with that.

negative.description: Looking for events to attend. The app manages the organizer's own events and has no event search.
negative.prompt: Find me a free tech meetup in Berlin this weekend.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any Gomry tool. ChatGPT answers on its own or says Gomry can't help with that.

negative.description: General writing request that needs no Gomry data.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about summer festivals.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any Gomry tool. ChatGPT answers on its own or says Gomry can't help with that.

publication.release_notes: First submission. Gomry's MCP server for event organizers: events, ticket types, attendees, contacts, invitations and reporting. Write and email actions are marked destructive so ChatGPT asks before running them, and subscription and bundle creation are not offered in ChatGPT.
